messages:
Alana (Sales): quick Q from the FinRegCo POC — they want an EU-only data path (inference, logs, and KMS in eu-west1) and no US subprocessors. can we commit to that for a hosted/dedicated POC? need impact on pricing and timeline. cc @Matt

Matt (Solutions): short summary: yes, with caveats. we can tenant-pin to an EU region for hosted in most cases and for Dedicated/Private it's straightforward. key points:
- subprocessors: our partner stack (cloud provider, some infra libs) has EU-region options but some 3rd-party vendors may still have US processing unless we use dedicated/private variants. legal attestation required.
- KMS: BYOK in customer's EU KMS is supported for Private and Dedicated. hosted-managed regional KMS is available as an uplift in some regions.
- routing & failover: default policy prefers same-region. failover order can be restricted to EU regions only; cross-continent failover is off by default and requires customer approval.

Taylor (Infra): capacity note: small reserved dedicated pool in eu-west1 can be spun up for POC. if customer requires strict single-region isolation (no shared pools at all), that pushes to Private/VPC or isolated Dedicated (longer lead time). provisioning ETA: ~10 business days for small dedicated, 2-3 weeks for isolated/private.

Jess (Legal): we need a signed subprocessors attestation and DPA amendment for region pinning. we can provide the attestation template. also callout: if the customer integrates public webhooks or third-party tools, we cannot guarantee those vendors wont route outside EU.

Alana (Sales): can you give me a concise pricing delta I can put in the quote (ballpark)? customer asked on the call.

Matt (Solutions): ballpark estimates (subject to final sizing):
- EU-dedicated tenant pin + platform uplift: ~+15% on the hosted baseline (covers reserved capacity + regional infra premium)
- regional/managed KMS (hosted -> regional KMS): +5-10%
- Private/on-prem: separate license + setup fee (we'll give a number after SOW).
These are placeholders for conversation — we'll send formal quote after sizing.

Taylor (Infra): if they opt for strict isolation, we should factor in a small redundancy plan inside EU (hot-standby in a second EU AZ/region) — adds ops cost.

ops-bot: routing-policy-change request #4247 created by @Matt — status: awaiting legal attestation + infra sizing.

Alana (Sales): thanks — i'll send attestation request to the customer. one more thing: do we have a short sample attestation doc i can attach to the email?

Jess (Legal): yes, i'll upload the sample attestation and DPA snippet to this thread in a few minutes. :thumbsup:

Matt (Solutions): sample routing config (for the engineer-on-call / customer's infra team) — paste for reference:
```
{
  "routing": {
    "tenant_pin": "eu-west1",
    "failover_order": ["eu-west1", "eu-central1"],
    "allow_cross_region_on_outage": false
  }
}
```

Alana (Sales): perfect. i'll update the deal room and loop the customer in. thanks everyone!
